payload.core_mechanism_summary: Counts gem color frequencies, sorts into a tuple, and uses a precomputed dictionary to map the frequency tuple to the number of distinct cube arrangements.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a hardcoded dictionary to look up the answer based on frequency distribution. No algorithm like heap, BFS, or sorting is actually used; the dictionary is the core data structure. Thus ds_hash_map is the most fitting subtype.
